# `k.auth`

Import each declaration by name, for example `import k.auth.Authenticated`.

| Declaration | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`Authenticated`](#authenticated) | The guard that refuses callers who aren't signed in. |
| [`AuthRole`](#authrole) | Marks the app's role enum; [`SessionUser.roles`](#sessionuser) is a `Set` of it. |
| [`AuthUserId`](#authuserid) | Marks the app's user id type, the type of [`SessionUser.id`](#sessionuser). |
| [`extend Int`](#extend-int) | Rates on whole numbers. |
| [`GuardRejection`](#guardrejection) | Why a guard refused an rpc call, carried by [`k.rpc.RpcFailure.rejected`](k-rpc.md#rpcfailure). |
| [`Rate`](#rate) | A number of calls per period, for [`RateLimit`](#ratelimit): `100.perMinute`. |
| [`RateLimit`](#ratelimit) | The guard that limits how often a client may call: `requires RateLimit(10.perMinute)`. |
| [`Role`](#role) | The guard that refuses users without a role: `requires Role(.admin)`. |
| [`Session`](#session) | Who is signed in, readable on both sides (`docs/design/26-auth-and-sessions.md`). |
| [`SessionConfig`](#sessionconfig) | Session lifetimes (`docs/design/25-config-and-secrets.md`, "Stdlib configs"). |
| [`SessionManager`](#sessionmanager) | Signs users in and out. |
| [`SessionRole`](#sessionrole) | The app's one enum implementing [`AuthRole`](#authrole), as an alias generated by the compiler; [`Role`](#role) (`Role(.admin)`) takes one of its cases. |
| [`SessionUser`](#sessionuser) | The signed-in user, generated for the app (`docs/design/26-auth-and-sessions.md`, "SessionUser is generated"). |
| [`SessionUserId`](#sessionuserid) | The app's one type implementing [`AuthUserId`](#authuserid), as an alias generated by the compiler. |

## Authenticated

```k,ignore
@Guard
public struct Authenticated
```

The guard that refuses callers who aren't signed in. On a page it
redirects to the page marked [`k.core.SignInPage`](k-core.md#signinpage); on an rpc it
throws `rpcFailure(.rejected(.unauthenticated))`
([`GuardRejection.unauthenticated`](#guardrejection)).

## AuthRole

```k,ignore
public interface AuthRole implements Equatable, Hashable, Codable
```

Marks the app's role enum; [`SessionUser.roles`](#sessionuser) is a `Set` of it. An
app declares at most one enum implementing it, which [`SessionRole`](#sessionrole)
stands for.

## AuthUserId

```k,ignore
public interface AuthUserId implements Equatable, Hashable, Codable
```

Marks the app's user id type, the type of [`SessionUser.id`](#sessionuser). An app
declares exactly one type implementing it, which [`SessionUserId`](#sessionuserid)
stands for.

## extend Int

```k,ignore
public extend Int
```

Rates on whole numbers.

**Members**

- `var perSecond: Rate`
  This many calls per second.
- `var perMinute: Rate`
  This many calls per minute.
- `var perHour: Rate`
  This many calls per hour.

## GuardRejection

```k,ignore
public enum GuardRejection implements Error, Codable
```

Why a guard refused an rpc call, carried by [`k.rpc.RpcFailure.rejected`](k-rpc.md#rpcfailure).

**Members**

- `case unauthenticated`
  Nobody is signed in ([`Authenticated`](#authenticated) refused the call).
- `case forbidden`
  The user lacks a required role ([`Role`](#role) refused the call).
- `case rateLimited(retryAfter: Duration)`
  The client exceeded a [`RateLimit`](#ratelimit); it may call again after
  `retryAfter`.

## Rate

```k,ignore
public struct Rate implements Equatable
```

A number of calls per period, for [`RateLimit`](#ratelimit): `100.perMinute`.

**Members**

- `var count: Int`
  The number of calls allowed per `period`.
- `var period: Duration`
  The period the `count` applies to.

## RateLimit

```k,ignore
@Guard
public struct RateLimit
```

The guard that limits how often a client may call: `requires
RateLimit(10.perMinute)`. Counted per session for signed-in clients and
per client address for guests.

**Members**

- `init(_ rate: Rate)`
  Allows at most `rate`.

  - Parameter rate: the allowed number of calls per period, such as
    `10.perMinute`.

## Role

```k,ignore
@Guard
public struct Role
```

The guard that refuses users without a role: `requires Role(.admin)`.
A compile error when the app declares no [`AuthRole`](#authrole) enum.

**Members**

- `init(_ role: SessionRole)`
  Requires `role`.

  - Parameter role: a case of the app's role enum ([`SessionRole`](#sessionrole)).

## Session

```k,ignore
@Scope(.app)
public service Session
```

Who is signed in, readable on both sides
(`docs/design/26-auth-and-sessions.md`). In the browser it is a read-only
mirror of the server's session.

**Members**

- `var user: SessionUser?`
  The signed-in user, or `nil` for a guest. Reactive. Its type is
  [`SessionUser`](#sessionuser), not optional, inside bodies guarded by
  [`Authenticated`](#authenticated).

## SessionConfig

```k,ignore
public config SessionConfig
```

Session lifetimes (`docs/design/25-config-and-secrets.md`, "Stdlib
configs").

## SessionManager

```k,ignore
@ServerOnly
public service SessionManager
```

Signs users in and out. Server-only, injectable only into server-side
services (`docs/design/26-auth-and-sessions.md`).

**Members**

- `func signIn(userId: SessionUserId, roles: Set<SessionRole> = Set([])) async`
  Starts a new session for the user, replacing any current one.

  - Parameters:
    - userId: the user who signed in.
    - roles: the user's roles; the parameter exists only when the app
      declares an [`AuthRole`](#authrole) enum.
- `func signOut() async`
  Ends the current session; does nothing for a guest.
- `func endAll(userId: SessionUserId) async`
  Ends every session of a user, on every device.

  - Parameter userId: the user whose sessions end.
- `func issueState() async -> String`
  Issues a random value bound to the current session (creating a guest
  session if needed), for an OAuth `state` parameter.

  - Returns: the value to send; check it on return with
    `consumeState(_:)`.
- `func consumeState(_ state: String) async -> Bool`
  Checks and consumes a value issued by `issueState()`.

  - Parameter state: the value the OAuth provider sent back.
  - Returns: `true` the first time it is called with a value issued to
    this session, `false` afterwards and for any other value.

## SessionRole

```k,ignore
public enum SessionRole implements Equatable, Hashable, Codable
```

The app's one enum implementing [`AuthRole`](#authrole), as an alias generated by
the compiler; [`Role`](#role) (`Role(.admin)`) takes one of its cases.

## SessionUser

```k,ignore
public struct SessionUser implements Equatable, Codable
```

The signed-in user, generated for the app
(`docs/design/26-auth-and-sessions.md`, "SessionUser is generated").
Needs no import.

**Members**

- `let id: SessionUserId`
  The user's id: the app's one type implementing [`AuthUserId`](#authuserid).
- `let roles: Set<SessionRole>`
  The user's roles; exists only when the app declares an
  [`AuthRole`](#authrole) enum.

## SessionUserId

```k,ignore
public struct SessionUserId implements Equatable, Hashable, Codable
```

The app's one type implementing [`AuthUserId`](#authuserid), as an alias generated by
the compiler. Using [`SessionManager`](#sessionmanager) with none, or several, is a
compile error.
